meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: MUST USE after building/changing any UI or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Rigorous visual QA across web/page and terminal UIs. Prefer browser:control-in-app-browser for unauthenticated browser/page QA in Codex, then Playwright/agent-browser/dev-browser. Captures screenshot/TUI evidence with bundled diff scripts, runs design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK reviewer passes, then synthesizes a good/bad verdict. Triggers: visual QA, screenshot/pixel diff, UI looks wrong, reference fidelity, design system check, responsive check, CJK text clipping, TUI alignment, box-drawing drift.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动检查UI页面和终端界面的视觉正确性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要自动化验证UI的像素级正确性
copy.tagline_en: Automatically verify visual correctness of UI pages and terminal interfaces
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated pixel-level UI verification

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会在你构建或改动任意界面后，先截网页或终端画面，用自带脚本做像素、宽度对比，再派两个只读检查员分别查设计系统和视觉细节，最后给出通过/不通过的意见，并附具体问题位置。
howto.when: 在你构建或改动任何界面之后，或当问题涉及界面外观是否正确时触发；你说“视觉QA”“截图对比”等也会启动。

say.text: 刚改完登录页，跑一遍视觉质检，给我结论
say.note: 会截当前页面并做对比审查。

say.text: 把这个文档TUI终端的框线和对齐检查一下
say.note: 会捕获真实终端画面并查宽度与错位。

say.text: 对照这张设计稿检查我的页面有哪些像素差异
say.note: 会做参考图与实测图的diff。

howto.what_en: After install, when you build or change UI, Claude captures screenshots/terminal frames, runs pixel diff, dispatches two read-only reviewers (design-system, visual-fidelity), then gives a pass/fail verdict with locations.
howto.when_en: Triggers after building or changing any UI, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right; also on requests like "visual QA" or "screenshot diff".

say_en.text: I just changed the login page; run visual QA and give me the verdict.
say_en.note: Captures the page and runs both review passes.

say_en.text: Check the borders and alignment of this TUI terminal.
say_en.note: Captures a real xterm.js frame and inspects width/alignment.

say_en.text: Compare this page against this design mock and list pixel diffs.
say_en.note: Diffs reference vs actual, then sends reviewers.
